This is an assurance evaluation, not an operational autonomy system. The system boundary is explicit: offline log replay only, using synthetic logs from a closed simulator and no deployment pathway. The review has no live cyber access, no live telemetry, no live sensor feeds, no physical actuators, no real targeting data, and no operational recommendations. It uses full logging, deterministic replay, audit trail, saved run manifests, human review as oversight rather than containment, deactivation procedure, and kill switch. Data sensitivity is low because all logs are synthetic. Misuse potential is explicitly considered and limited by offline-only execution. Non-interference with the real world is the top-level assurance claim.
